about: The artifact hotbar: Minecraft Dungeons artifacts built from Elden Ring items. Three hotbar slots (controls artifact_1..3). Artifacts drop as loot and are slotted from the satchel (controls artifact_menu). The Elden Ring item's name is read from the game's own text at runtime and shown next to the Dungeons name.
